notes: Max-out upgrade costs now respect DPS tiers: the three weakest combat towers stay under 1,000 total, 50-90 max DPS under 5,000, 90-150 under 15,000, 200-300 under 50,000, and the top band (300+) caps at 69,900 (Lance).
Upgrade steps are back-loaded and exponential - early levels are cheap, the final levels are the real investment.
Early and mid-game towers stay fully playable: Rivet maxes out at 3,100, Swarm at 800, and the Singularity Well at 200.
